name: stress-ng logmath
description: Start N workers that exercise various libm logarithmic functions with input values 1 to 10000. Results are sanity checked to ensure no variation occurs after each round of 10000 computations. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
